title: Northstar rehearsal capacity
scope: One rehearsal week; Chen, Jules and Ari; known rehearsal, support and coordination demand
period: Fictional rehearsal week; exact dates unspecified

people.name: Chen
people.timing_note: Mapping validation and restore preparation may overlap inside the week.

people.name: Jules
people.timing_note: Coordination capacity does not establish restore-engineering capability.

allocations.note: Includes evidence review and issue routing.

people.timing_note: An incident response allocation is known to exist but its hours are not yet bounded.

allocations.note: Unknown demand is retained instead of entered as zero.

constraints.conflict: Chen has 32 known demand hours against 28 modeled available hours.
constraints.consequence: The baseline is resource constrained by four hours.

constraints.window: Potential parallel window inside rehearsal week
constraints.conflict: Both activities may require Chen at the same time even if weekly demand is balanced later.
constraints.consequence: A weekly-only fix could leave an infeasible daily sequence.
Ari's displayed spare balance cannot be treated as committed capacity.

options.label: Transfer four support hours
options.hours_timing_changed: Move 4 hours of Chen's support duty in the actual required window.
options.skill_basis: A competent recipient must accept coverage.
options.effect: Balances Chen's weekly known demand; daily overlap still needs checking.
options.recalculated_result: Chen known demand becomes 28 hours and remaining becomes 0.
options.note: Jules can coordinate the request but cannot approve it by default.

options.label: Resequence rehearsal work
options.hours_timing_changed: Move eligible validation or preparation to a later available window.
options.skill_basis: Uses Chen's existing skill without assuming substitution.
options.effect: May move the integrated forecast or required rehearsal window.
options.recalculated_result: Requires the actual task network and later-period capacity.
options.note: Resource ordering must not be presented as a technical dependency.

options.label: Use vendor help
options.hours_timing_changed: Unknown until a named contribution is defined.
options.skill_basis: Skill, access, availability and supervision are not evidenced.
options.effect: Could reduce work only after net productive capacity is established.
options.recalculated_result: Not calculable from the supplied case.
options.note: No free vendor capacity is assumed.

presentation.headline: A balanced week can still hide an impossible window
presentation.lede: Chen is four hours overloaded, Ari has unknown incident demand, and the rehearsal sequence still needs a daily skill check.
presentation.insight_heading: Hours, skills and windows must agree
insight_points: Chen's known weekly shortage is four hours.
Ari's unknown duty prevents an unconditional spare-capacity claim.
presentation.decision: Confirm support coverage or resequence eligible rehearsal work through the proper authority, then validate daily concurrency and Ari's unknown incident demand.

analysis.method: Known person-level demand compared with modeled weekly availability; timing and skill constraints remain explicit checks.
analysis.support_treatment: Existing-system support is an allocation and is not deducted again as overhead.
analysis.completeness: Vendor contribution is absent; Ari's incident demand is explicitly unknown; exact rehearsal dates are not supplied.

notes: Fictional instructional data; option arithmetic is conditional and does not approve a reassignment.
